*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scrollbar-width:none}html::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
body{min-height:100vh;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:var(--font);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:clip}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #6B5C5C;outline-offset:3px}

.wrap{max-width:88rem;margin:0 auto;padding:24px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) 0 max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left))}

.top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding-bottom:56px}

.intro{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:20px;padding-bottom:64px;text-align:left}
.intro h1{white-space:nowrap;font-size:clamp(34px,8.2vw,104px)}
h1{font-size:clamp(44px,7vw,84px);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:.95}
.intro p{max-width:52ch;font-size:17px;line-height:1.55;color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.68)}
.intro .count{display:block;margin-top:14px;font-family:ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent)}

/* ---------- stacked project cards ---------- */
.stack{position:relative;padding-bottom:12vh}
.card{position:sticky;top:calc(var(--nav-h,72px) + 16px + var(--i) * 14px);margin-bottom:6vh;border-radius:28px;background:var(--card);box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  border:1px solid var(--card-line);transform-origin:50% 0;will-change:transform;overflow:hidden}
.card__in{display:grid;gap:28px;padding:28px;min-height:min(calc(100vh - var(--nav-h,72px) - 120px),720px)}
@media (min-width:900px){
  .card__in{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,5fr) minmax(0,7fr);align-items:center;gap:40px;padding:48px 52px}
  .card.flip .card__in{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,7fr) minmax(0,5fr)}
  .card.flip .card__info{order:2}
}
.card__dim{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#000;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;border-radius:inherit}
.card__meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:22px;font-family:ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent)}
.card__meta .no{color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.4)}
